name: ticket-api

dependencies.name: ai-classification-service
dependencies.description: Classifies a newly submitted ticket's urgency and generates its draft reply, synchronously on creation.

description: Owns the Ticket entity end to end: accepts anonymous ticket submissions, calls the AI classification service to set urgency and generate a draft reply immediately on submission, and exposes the queue (list/filter/detail) and the edit/approve/resolve actions a signed-in Support Agent uses. Does not send replies to customers and does not manage agent accounts or roles.
